---
name: jira-engineering-research
description: Documenting changes to make other engineers know what changes and what was done
---

Write an engineer research by look at the previous commit that was done or make some planning changes about what could the issues or the improvements. 

The template would be the background of the issues, the next section would be findings resolved or could be any section that match with the context. 

In the findings resolved, attach the title of the issues then what was the problem and what was done. If it was the research, attach the findings of the issues and scope it what was could be impacted and how the approach could be resolved and give the pros and cons about the approach. Give the recomendation and why we would choose that.

Do not use any complicated language, make it simple and easy to read by other engineers. 

Redact any sensitive information, such as API keys, passwords, or personally identifiable information.

The last one is summary of all the research of the findings
